label: Updated 8 PM ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Memorial 4-Way Lead
items.text: Wyndham Clark, JJ Spaun, Tommy Fleetwood, and Ryan Gerard share the first-round lead at the Memorial at 5-under 67, with Clark eagling the 15th and Spaun birdieing 18.

items.headline: Bryson DeChambeau Wedge Break
items.text: Bryson DeChambeau’s wedge snapped when he used it as a cane walking the 12th fairway at LIV Golf Andalucia, costing him a shot in his opening 1-under 70 round.

items.headline: Tiger on Golf GOAT
items.text: Tiger Woods calls Jack Nicklaus “the greatest leader,” but journalist Bob Harig says Woods might privately consider himself the greatest player at his peak due to his major-winning dominance.
